Holywood's Rory McIlroy is one the favourites for The Open while Irish golfer Shane Lowry is hoping to win in Portrush, just like he did in 2019 when the championship was last played at the seaside town.

Rory McIlroy from Holywood is considered one of the favorites for The Open, while Shane Lowry from Ireland aims to secure a victory in Portrush, similar to his triumph in 2019 when the championship last took place in the coastal town.

Earlier this year, he nearly achieved a second major victory after trailing by seven strokes on the final day of the Masters, ultimately pushing the competition into a play-off with Rory McIlroy, who would go on to become the champion.
